text.description_html:
PDQ CL126ORL, CL Series Entrance Set with Orlando Lever

The CL Series Entrance Set by PDQ offers ANSI/BHMA Grade 2 security. The Orlando Entrance Set is adjustable for doors 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches thick; and it has an optional backset for either 2-3/4 inches or 2-3/8 inches. The Orlando style designer commercial levers have a modern appearance that makes it great for contemporary office buildings and other commercial applications.

Also Available: Orlando Leverset

Features of the PDQ Orlando Entrance Set:

  • Complies with ANSI/BHMA 156.12-2013, Grade 2
  • ADA compliant thumbturn.
  • Keyways: Schlage "C" Standard (keyed functions).
  • Cylinder: Brass 6-pin cylinder keyed to 5-pins.
  • Door Prep: Fits standard 160 or 161 door prep.

Specifications for PDQ CL Series Orlando Commercial Lever Entrance Set:

  • Exterior Rose Diameter: 3-3/8"
  • Interior Escutcheon Width: 3-3/4”
  • Interior Escutcheon Height: 9-3/4”
  • Door Thickness: Adjustable for 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" thick.
  • Backset: adjustable for either 2-3/4" or 2-3/8"
  • Latchbolt: 1/2" Throw
  • Deadbolt: 1" Throw
  • Handing: Non-Handed Lever.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Cylinder Entrance Passage Lever (ANSI F95): Outside and Inside lever always free Entry. Deadbolt projected or retracted by key outside and a turnpiece inside. When deadbolt is actived, turning inside ever retracts deadbolt and latchbolt simultaneously.
  • Double Cylinder Entrance Privacy Lever (ANSI F97): Outside lever locked by turn button in inside lever. Inside lever always free entry.Unlocking of outside lever requires use of key or manual return of inside turn button. Deadbolt is activated by key in outside and a turnpiece inside. Turning inside lever retracts deadbolt and latchbolt simultaneously.
  • Storeroom Double Cylinder Privacy Lever (ANSI F98): Deadlocking latch bolt is operated by key outside or operating lever. Key outside projects or retracts dead bolt. Operating inside lever or key outside retracts dead bolt Privacy Lever and deadlocking latch.
